name: openl
description: Work with OpenL Studio from Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code — manage rules, projects, tables and tests over the OpenL MCP server.

studio_base_url.title: OpenL Studio address
studio_base_url.description: OpenL Studio's own address, without the page you are on, e.g. https://studio.example.com or http://localhost:8080

studio_token.title: Personal Access Token
studio_token.description: Create one in OpenL Studio under User → Personal Access Tokens, then paste it here. This is how Claude signs in as you. Leave empty only for a single-user Studio that has no sign-in. Run /openl:connect and Claude will walk you through it.
